notes.title: Game speed fix
notes.content: The game used to run too fast on powerful video cards. But it's fixed now. The game runs with a nice speed and totally playable even on the fastest video cards since now on.

notes.title: New patch
notes.content:
Five hot seat maps have been added

Some little bugs have been fixed

notes.title: New patch: gamepad and mouse controls
notes.content:
Mouse now can be used to control the gun. You can turn mouse control on in the options.

Gamepad can be used to control everything, instead of keyboard.

notes.title: Singleplayer campaign is alive
notes.content:
Today's patch has provided the following updates:

 - 12 levels of the singlaplayer campaign are available
 - Options choices are being saved between the sessions
 - Start/win money can be adjusted before a hot seat game

notes.content:
The new patch fixes some minor bugs, but also there's now controls configuration option under "options".

Does anyone have any feedback about the weapons? The prices, damage, how they affect the ground. Maybe some ideas about new weapons?

notes.title: The bugs have been fixed
notes.content:
There have two major bugs been reported:

[b]1. Game crashed on tank explosion.[/b]
This has been fixed in the recent patch. Steam client should automatically update your game the next time you login Steam.

[b]2. The "no sounds", "no camera follow", "no zoom", "no launch/impact visuals" problem.[/b]
This problem is a result of outdated videocard drivers. Please, if you have any of these issues, update your videocard drivers to the most recent version.
